_comment: Non-localised constants. Everything the user sees is in strings/.

language_rows._comment: The Settings -> Language picker's rows, in order (row 0 is the title). 'system' follows the device; the rest are language codes. The names are each language's own name, so the list reads the same whatever the app is currently set to — that is what lets the harness pick a row without knowing the current language.

versions._comment: The two releases the flows use. Bump these (or pass --latest/--older) when upstream moves on.
